about.title: Project: molding-press
about.summary: One press, 12 products in 3 families. Each run is 60 days.

status.headline: 1 problem to fix before you can race.

assumptions: demand is Poisson per product per day
one changeover per day at most, made before the day's output
unmet demand is lost, not back-ordered

rules.label: Family campaign
rules.about: Stay with one family until it is stocked up, then move on.

rules.label: Lowest stock first
rules.about: Make the product that will run out first.

rules.label: ABC wheel
rules.about: Run products in a set order. Fast sellers get a turn often, slow sellers less often.

rules.label: Biggest dollar shortfall
rules.about: Run the product whose missing stock is worth the most money.

rules.label: Fixed wheel
rules.about: Run every product in the same order, a set number of days each.

rules.label: Kanban
rules.about: Kanban cards: refill a product when it drops under a share of its target.

rules.label: Lowest cover
rules.about: Make the product that will run out first.

rules.label: Best for today only
rules.about: Run what earns the most money today. It does not plan for tomorrow.

rules.label: Random
rules.about: Pick any product, or rest the press, at random.

rules.label: Reorder point
rules.about: The (s, S) rule: refill a product when it drops to s, up to S.

rules.label: Changeover-aware run-out
rules.about: Make what runs out first, but count a product switch as lost days.

views.name: abc_cover
views.about: How full each ABC class is, and which family the press is set up for.

views.name: family
views.about: Lowest stock in each family. Also the family on the line.

views.name: family_cover
views.about: How full each family is, and which family the press is set up for.

views.name: simple
views.about: How full each family is, and which family the line is set for.
